hero.title: Grow by bringing ambitious brands into the valley.
hero.description: Join Virtual Valley as a Growth Partner and earn commissions for every successful client referral across website development, website repair, and social media management.

opportunityPoints: Earn on every successful referral without handling delivery yourself.
Recommend trusted services to founders, creators, and local businesses.
Work remotely from any city while building recurring monthly income.
Get priority support from the Virtual Valley team when leads are active.

commissionTiers.label: Starter Partner
commissionTiers.description: For partners getting started with occasional referrals.

commissionTiers.label: Growth Partner
commissionTiers.description: For partners who consistently refer qualified leads.

commissionTiers.label: Elite Partner
commissionTiers.description: For high-performing partners with repeat monthly conversions.

rules: Commission is released after the client completes the first approved payment milestone.
Duplicate leads are assigned to the earliest verified submission.
Misleading claims, spam outreach, or fake leads result in immediate removal.
Partners must represent pricing and timelines responsibly.
Virtual Valley may update program terms and payout rules with notice.
